search_console.decision: The report covered data through September 13 and returned zero clicks, zero impressions, and no query or page rows for BigBudMan.com. No data-led topic was justified; the empty sample was ignored for topic selection, while old sitemap errors informed stronger crawl paths.

authority.action: Published an NIH, CDC, FDA, and NHTSA grounded older-adult conversation record, connected it to medication, heart, driving, and responsible-use guidance, and logged a qualified National Council on Aging opportunity. The grow-light worksheet adds transparent energy arithmetic and connects the home-grow and gear clusters; no outreach was sent.
